## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `7e57a1c7a41cc23840df1d2896f8dd61838f4838` · 2026-11-25T22:03Z

PR #37348 → card #37237 (sub-card of #36890). Final report 7174682607. Zone head freeze 7175473312 (2026-11-25T21:43Z). Everything below was read against GitHub and a throwaway worktree at the head. None of it is taken from the report.

**Checklist**

- **Shape (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37348`: CLEAN, 13 items, none flagged).** The PR is an open draft against `main`. Its first line is `Fixes #37237`, and no closing keyword binds another card. Nothing touches `content/docs/releases/`. There is one changeset, and it is not empty. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check are both `success`. `Fixes` is right: the diff delivers the whole card (dashboard and report through the base app, × back to the list, the three pinned cases, and the reachability confirmation).
- **Fix matches the card.** `StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx` reads the open package's apps once. If the target is an item, that read is empty, and `customizationPairBaseOf(packageId)` names a base, it makes one read of the base's apps. It then runs the unchanged decision-6 rule (`studioAppEditSegment`) with `packageId: appPackageId` (the base). `customizationPairBaseOf` is the existing shipped helper. It is pure and wraps spec's `customizationBasePackageId` (`.custom` suffix plus a round-trip check), and `StudioDesignSurface` and `StudioPermissionSetPage` already use it. The diff stays inside the claim's file surface: `studioAppEdit.ts` (doc paragraph only), `StudioAreaAppOpen.tsx`, the shared test file, and a changeset. There is no server, spec or route change.
- **Extra read only in the stated case.** The base read is guarded by `target.kind === 'item' && apps.length === 0 && pairBase !== null`.
  - A plain package with apps makes one read, as before.
  - A plain package with no app makes one read. The CONTROL pin `toEqual([['app', { packageId: PKG }]])` now asserts this.
  - A pair with its own app makes one read, pinned.
  - New-report never takes the leg, because of the `kind` guard. Q1 A holds: New on the pair's own area is unchanged.
  - On the pair leg, the remembered-app menu read (`client.get('app', …)`) is now skipped when the remembered app is one of the base's. So the pair leg costs at most one extra request, and sometimes none.
  - A `cancelled` check comes before the second read.
- **Replacing the old pin is justified.** I ran main's test file (merge-base `a182fbe3`) against the head source. Exactly one case went red: 「a pair row keeps the generic item page: the pair has no published app of its own」. The other 24 stayed green (`Tests 1 failed | 24 passed (25)`). That pin asserted the item page plus a single `[app PAIR]` read, which is the defect the card names. Its two assertions are still covered:
  - The generic page on a pair is covered by 「a pair whose base has no published app」.
  - The single read is covered by the plain CONTROL and by 「a pair with a published app of its own」.

  The old pin mounted `/studio/PAIR/…` through the same `PackageArea` route that the new cases use, so no route lost coverage.
- **Reachability (Q2 A).** `areaLocationRedirect` (`metadataArea.ts:291`) re-roots any leg whose `?package=` names another package, whether or not a `customization` prop is present. The reach pin mounts `/studio/BASE/…?package=PAIR` and lands on `/apps/BASE/dashboard/headcount` with `?studio=` set to the pair's list. `StudioDesignSurface` sends pillar URLs of a pair to the base, but explicitly not the area (`props.area`). So the pair-scoped area is a real route.
- **Declarations.** `readClause2Line` (`scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs`) gives `{kind: declared, value: no, arm: null}` for the card's newest `Claim:` comment 7172779719, the PR body, and the changeset body, all three identically. `readMetadataProtocolLine` gives `declared · none` for all three. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed.
- **Changeset.** The `@object-ui/app-shell` entry is a `patch`. The package is `private: true`, but it is versioned under `privatePackages` and listed in `fixed`, and main already has 189 changesets for it, so this follows convention. `patch` agrees with `Metadata-protocol: none`. I checked each sentence against the diff:
  - 「They now open in the base package's app」: true.
  - 「The app page's × goes back to the Studio list you left」: true. `?studio=` is the pair's list.
  - 「A customization package whose base has no published app keeps the generic item page」: true.
  - 「…that does publish an app of its own opens there, as before」: true.
  - 「Every other package is unchanged. No props, exports or routes change」: true.
  - 「picked the same way as for any package: the app you came from … otherwise the base's first app」: abbreviated, see N2.
- **Pins at head and ablation.** In the worktree at `7e57a1c7` I ran `vitest run --root ../.. StudioAreaAppOpen-36906.test.tsx studioAppEdit.test.ts` and got `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 29 passed (29)`. I then ran four ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob changed), and each was restored with `blob == HEAD … git diff HEAD is empty`:

  | leg | mutation | red at head |
  |---|---|---|
  | A1 | `customizationPairBaseOf(packageId) : null` → `null : null` | 4 failed: pair dashboard, reach from the base list, pair report, base without an app |
  | A2 | `packageId: appPackageId, apps` → `packageId, apps` | 2 failed: pair dashboard, reach from the base list |
  | A3 | `&& apps.length === 0 ?` → `&& true ?` | 1 failed: pair with its own app |
  | A4 CONTROL | `?? 'com.example.hr'` fallback on the leg | 1 failed: package with no published app (single read) |

- **Check-runs at head.** There are 51 runs: 38 success, 13 skipped, 0 failed, 0 pending. `l1-face` judges all 13 skips expected (0 unexpected). Nothing is dogfood-owed: the title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.
- **Merge-tree and overlap.** Against current `origin/main` `134b71db`, `git merge-tree --write-tree` exits 0, and no main-side commit touches the PR's files. #37351 (`c9c1d9e4`) and #37347 (`f781168f`) share no file with this PR. Pairwise merge-tree exits 0 for each, and so does a three-way merge of main plus #37348 with each of them.
- **K = 7.** That is `git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main` at `134b71db`. The zone's freeze read 6, and main has moved one commit since. All 7 commits are outside these files.
- **维护者速读 accuracy.** All four lines hold:
  - Line 1 (pair dashboard or report opens in the base app's edit state or builder, and × returns to the list) matches the pins and the changeset.
  - Line 2 matches #36890 (「Studio 重构」) and #36906.
  - Line 3 (the worst case is the generic page or another base app, with no data written, and a revert restores it) matches the code: the leg only navigates and reads.
  - Line 4 「无」 is right, because this is a Tier S landing that the zone does itself.
- **Contract review.** None is owed. The PR declares `Clause-②: no` with no `(narrowing)` arm. It touches no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path: all four files are under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/**` or `.changeset/`.

**Findings**

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- N1 — The header docblock of `StudioAreaAppOpen-36906.test.tsx` (lines 17–19) still says 「a read-only base: its own rows open in its app, a pair row keeps the generic page」. This PR inverts that behaviour, and the file's new `objectstack#37237` describe pins the opposite. It is a test-only comment and does not affect correctness. I accept it as a deviation, to be fixed on the file's next touch.
- N2 — The changeset's paraphrase of decision 6 (「the app you came from when it is one of the base's, otherwise the base's first app」) leaves out rule 1's menu leg. That leg is an outside app whose menu opens the item (`studioAppEditSegment`, `rememberedMenu`), and the code keeps it. #36906's changeset names it. The sentence's lead clause, 「picked the same way as for any package」, is accurate. Accepted.
- N3 — The PR body's ablation table was taken before the reach pin landed in `7e57a1c7`. At head, A1 reds 4 rather than 3 and A2 reds 2 rather than 1, and every leg is still red. Separately, the report's `gates` field lists Test Core and Dogfood Regression Gate as success, but both are expected skips at head on this ui-only diff. These are evidence-accuracy notes only. No action.

**Landing**

- The zone lands it, Tier S: not governed, +118/−19 (well under 3,000), no L2 owed. K = 7 (< 15), so the zone does not need to merge main first. Re-read the check-runs at the landing head.
